meta.revisionPolicy: Survey estimates are final on release; MoSPI may revise a table without notice, and each fetch is checked against the archived rows.
meta.coverage: Percentage distribution of hospitalised cases (excluding childbirth) over detailed ailment types during last 365 days: every state and UT, at the headline of sector, gender, ailments
meta.note: Baked from data/raw/profiles-mospi/nss75-1-4.json (657 rows as MoSPI serves them). Standard cuts kept at their headline value: sector = Rural + Urban; gender = Person; ailments = All Other Fevers (Includes, Typhoid, Fever With Rash, Etc.). The finer grain is in the raw dump.
meta.vintageNote: The MoSPI eSankhyiki response does not publish a data revision timestamp. Its archive capture date is recorded separately and must not be treated as the source revision date.
